title: Replication Check
summary: YTIntel now checks whether a winning mechanism repeats across other saved winners before treating one competitor video like a proven pattern.
discord_changes: Cross-checks current mechanisms against saved same-niche winners and controls.
Caps a single-video GO at TEST until independent winner replication exists.
Flags patterns that also appear heavily in ordinary-performing control videos.
changes: Added automatic cross-video replication after every deep analysis using the existing niche research library.
Added winner-versus-control matching for transferable mechanics so common style is not mistaken for a winning driver.
Added independent-channel requirements before a mechanism can be labelled REPLICATED.
Added a replication cap that downgrades a single-video GO to TEST until the mechanism repeats across multiple winner channels.
Added control-heavy warnings when the same mechanism also appears repeatedly in ordinary-performing videos.
Added a copyable Replication Brief and direct jump into niche History for further validation.
Refreshed the PWA cache so installed YTIntel copies receive v0.11.2 automatically.
why_it_matters: One breakout can be noise, creator-specific style or luck. Replication Check makes YTIntel demand repeatable cross-video evidence before confidence increases, reducing the chance of building around a one-off winner.
